definitions.short: a multitude ; also offspring ; specifically interest (on capital)
definitions.full: H4768. marbith מַרְבִּית noun feminine increase, great number, greatness ; — ׳מ absolute Lev 25:37 ; construct 1Sam 2:33 + 2t.; suffix מַרְבִּיתָם 1Chr 12:30 (van d. H. v. 12:29 ); — 1 increase , concrete: a. of family 1Sam 2:33 . b. increment, interest, usury , Lev 25:37 (H; of food-stuffs, || נֶשֶׁךְ , of money; ׳מ of money Egyptian Aramaic, opposed to ראש principal , Cooke North-Semitic Inscr. 404 ). 2 great number: of people 2Chr 30:18 ; with suffix = the greater part of them, 1Chr 12:30 (see above). 3 greatness , of wisdom 2Chr 9:6 .
